lead: K. Palaniswami is an Indian politician, born on 2 March 1954 in Edappadi.
As of 2026, he is 72 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly and Member of the Lok Sabha.
This profile collects the K. facts readers search for most — date of birth and current age, height and physical stats, family and relationship details, education, and a dated career timeline.

sections.heading: K. Palaniswami — Career and Professional Work
paras: His professional record lists politician and agronomist as his occupations.

He has held the following offices: Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly (1989–1996), Member of the Lok Sabha (1998–1999), Member of the Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly (2011–present), Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2017–2021), Member of the 16th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly (2021–present) and Member of the 17th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with All India Anna Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam.
